mapper.select: SELECT CASE #{targetType} WHEN 'POST' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE post_id = #{targetId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y') WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE comment_id = #{targetId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y') WHEN 'RECRUIT' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recruit WHERE recruit_id = #{targetId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y') WHEN 'CHAT' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recruit_chat WHERE chat_id = #{targetId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y') ELSE 0 END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report (target_type, target_id, reason_cd, reason, status_type, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}::integer, NULLIF(#{reasonCd}, ''), #{reason}, 'PENDING', 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.select:
SELECT r.report_id::TEXT AS row_id, r.target_type, r.target_id, r.reason_cd, r.reason, r.status_type, (SELECT c.name FROM code c WHERE c.code_id = r.reason_cd AND c.p_code_id = 'REPORT00') AS reason_name, (SELECT u.nickname FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_name, TO_CHAR(r.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt, CASE r.target_type WHEN 'POST' THEN (SELECT title FROM post WHERE post_id = r.target_id) WHEN 'RECRUIT' THEN (SELECT title FROM recruit WHERE recruit_id = r.target_id) WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN (SELECT LEFT(content, 40) FROM comment WHERE comment_id = r.target_id) WHEN 'CHAT' THEN (SELECT LEFT(content, 40) FROM recruit_chat WHERE chat_id = r.target_id) END AS target_title, -- 대상으로 이동할 링크(관리자가 신고 내용을 직접 확인). 대상 삭제 시 NULL/미존재. CASE r.target_type WHEN 'POST' THEN (SELECT '/gen/board/' || b.board_id || '?post=' || b.post_id FROM post b WHERE b.post_id = r.target_id) WHEN 'RECRUIT' THEN '/gen/recruit/' || r.target_id WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN (SELECT '/gen/board/' || b.board_id || '?post=' || b.post_id FROM comment c JOIN post b ON b.post_id = c.post_id WHERE c.comment_id = r.target_id)
WHEN 'CHAT' THEN (SELECT '/gen/recruit/' || ch.recruit_id FROM recruit_chat ch WHERE ch.chat_id = r.target_id) END AS link_url FROM report r WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' AND r.status_type = #{statusType} ORDER BY r.report_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE report SET status_type = #{statusType}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE report_id = #{rowId}::integer
